description: This Java source file defines the DeadlockDetector class, which inspects process and thread snapshots to detect deadlocks involving locks and binder transactions in Android system traces.

classes.name: DeadlockDetector
classes.description: A utility class for detecting deadlocks in Android process traces.

classes.name: ThreadRecord
classes.description: Represents a thread involved in potential deadlock cycles, with process and thread snapshots.

classes.name: LockRecord
classes.description: Represents a lock held by a process and thread, used for deadlock detection.

methods.name: detectDeadlocks
methods.description: Detects deadlocks affecting the main thread of a specified process ID within VM traces.

methods.name: addLockRecordsForThread
methods.description: Adds lock records for locks held by a specific thread to the set of locks to visit during deadlock detection.
